name: Barbarian audit: Rapid Recovery spell modifier reaches its target spells (#2550)
contract: Rapid Recovery (705171) promises that Onslaught (801758) effects occur 50% faster. Its native SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER for SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME reduces a 2000 ms interval to 1000 ms through Player::ApplySpellMod. This scenario checks that modifier independently with a 100000 ms input, while barbarian-rapid-recovery-duration-6726 observes native Energy ticks, unchanged ten-second duration, expiry and removal through normal advancement acquisition. The undescribed 5000 ms duration modifier in effect 2 is disabled by the Barbarian spell contract.
